readme_quotes:
## Installation
Installation of ManiSkill is extremely simple, you only need to run a few pip installs and setup Vulkan for rendering.
```bash
# install the package
pip install --upgrade mani_skill
# install a version of torch that is compatible with your system
pip install torch
```
Finally you also need to set up Vulkan with [instructions here](...)
sudo apt-get install libvulkan1 (installation.md Vulkan section)
If /usr/share/vulkan/icd.d/nvidia_icd.json does not exist, try to create the file... (installation.md)
If /etc/vulkan/implicit_layer.d/nvidia_layers.json does not exist, try to create the file... (installation.md)
dockerfile_quotes: RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y ... libvulkan1 vulkan-tools libvulkan-dev mesa-vulkan-drivers libegl1 libegl-mesa0 libosmesa6 ...
RUN uv pip install torch --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu128 --index-strategy unsafe-best-match
RUN uv pip install --upgrade mani_skill==3.0.0b22 --index-strategy unsafe-best-match
ambiguities: README says 'pip install torch' with no version or CUDA variant. Host driver reports CUDA 12.8, so cu128 wheel index is used.
README pins no specific mani_skill version. Used 3.0.0b22 matching the setup.py __version__.
needs_setuptools_pin quirk: sapien uses pkg_resources which breaks with setuptools>=81. Pin injected before and after main install to survive transitive upgrades.
needs_render_libs quirk: libegl1 / libosmesa6 / libgl1 required for headless rendering.
needs_vulkan_icd quirk: expanded Vulkan apt set (libvulkan-dev, mesa-vulkan-drivers, libegl-mesa0) to ensure full ICD chain for SAPIEN3 in headless container.
